name: apparatus
description: Build an interactive explainer for a React Native or Expo app — a small isometric machine whose working is the idea being explained, drawn with react-native-svg, moved on the UI thread with Reanimated and Gesture Handler, and framed in a PanelUI card with a live readout. Use when someone asks to explain how something works inside an app (a spring animation, rate limiting, a cache, an engine, a cell, an algorithm), wants a how-it-works or onboarding illustration that responds to touch, an interactive diagram or technical drawing on a phone screen, or a "show me how X works" figure, even if they never say "isometric" or "machine". Not for charts of data (use the chart components) or for the web.

name: logo-maker
description: Design an original app logo — a compact mascot or symbol that stays readable at 32 × 32 and works as an icon at every size. Use when asked to create, design or generate a logo, app icon, brand mark, mascot or avatar for a product, whether or not an image generator is available. Produces either a vector file the project can keep or a prompt for an image model, from one shared set of design rules.

name: panelui
description: Build React Native and Expo UIs with PanelUI — adding components, theming, composing overlays and forms, and debugging why something is unstyled. Applies when working in an Expo or React Native project that has panelui-native installed or a panelui.json, when the user mentions PanelUI, or when they ask for a bottom sheet, dialog, chart, chat transcript, form or any other screen UI in React Native.

name: panelui-web
description: Build React web UIs with PanelUI's web collection — adding its components from the shadcn registry or from npm, colouring them from the theme, and composing them into framed panels. Applies when working in a React project that has shadcn/ui set up with a @panelui registry or has panelui-web installed, when the user mentions PanelUI on the web, or when they ask for a dotted globe, a KPI card, a kanban board, a node graph, an activity grid or a feedback dialog in React.
